items.title: 9.2 Sum and Difference Formulas for Inverse Trigonometric Functions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 269-272: 9.2 Sum and Difference Formulas, formulas (i)-(vi) with proofs, Remember! box, Examples 8-11

blocks.text: Is sabaq mein hum inverse trigonometric functions ke jama (sum) aur farq (difference) ke formulas banayenge aur seekhenge ke inhein kahan aur kyun lagate hain. Pichle sabaq (9.1) mein aap ne dekha ke \(\sin^{-1}x\), \(\cos^{-1}x\), \(\tan^{-1}x\) asal mein angles hain, aur har ek ki apni principal range hai. Aaj ka poora sabaq do cheezon par khara hai: woh principal ranges, aur \(\sin(\alpha \pm \beta)\), \(\cos(\alpha \pm \beta)\), \(\tan(\alpha \pm \beta)\) ke purane formulas jo aap Class 11 mein parh chuke hain.

Kitab kehti hai: is section mein hum inverse trigonometric functions ke addition aur subtraction formulas derive karenge. Yeh identities buniyadi trigonometric identities aur thori algebra se banti hain, aur sirf principal values ke andar sahi hoti hain. Neeche inverse sine, cosine aur tangent ke chhe (6) formulas diye gaye hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Bilkul buniyad se shuru karte hain. \(\sin^{-1}x\) ek angle hai: woh angle jo \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein ho aur jis ka sine \(x\) ho. Is liye \(\sin^{-1}x + \sin^{-1}y\) sirf do angles ka jama hai, aur kuch nahi.
Do angles ke jama ka sine, cosine aur tangent hum pehle se jaante hain (Remember! box). To har proof mein bas teen qadam hain:
1. Har inverse ko ek naam do: \(\alpha\) aur \(\beta\), aur likho \(\sin\alpha = x\), \(\sin\beta = y\) (ya cos, ya tan).
2. \(\alpha + \beta\) ya \(\alpha - \beta\) par purana trigonometric formula lagao.
3. Dono taraf inverse function le kar wapas inverse ki zubaan mein aa jao.
Yeh formulas chahiye kyun? Yeh do inverse functions ko jor kar ek bana dete hain. Isi se numbers wali identities prove hoti hain (Exercise 9.2) aur Example 11 jaisi equations hal hoti hain. Aap ise aise samjhiye jaise do alag currencies ko ek currency mein badal kar jama karna: pehle sab ko ek shakal mein lao, phir jama karo.
Ab woh chhe formulas dekhiye. Inhein ratta lagane se pehle in ki shakal ko pehchaaniye, taa ke yaad rakhna aasaan ho jaye.

blocks.text_alt: (i) inverse sine of x plus inverse sine of y equals inverse sine of (x times root of 1 minus y squared, plus y times root of 1 minus x squared)
(ii) inverse sine of x minus inverse sine of y equals inverse sine of (x times root of 1 minus y squared, minus y times root of 1 minus x squared)
(iii) inverse cosine of x plus inverse cosine of y equals inverse cosine of (x y minus root of (1 minus x squared) times (1 minus y squared))
(iv) inverse cosine of x minus inverse cosine of y equals inverse cosine of (x y plus root of (1 minus x squared) times (1 minus y squared))
(v) inverse tangent of x plus inverse tangent of y equals inverse tangent of (x plus y) over (1 minus x y)
(vi) inverse tangent of x minus inverse tangent of y equals inverse tangent of (x minus y) over (1 plus x y)

blocks.text:
In formulas ko parhne ka aasaan tareeqa yeh hai:
Sine wale (i) aur (ii) mein bracket ke andar bilkul \(\sin(\alpha \pm \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta \pm \cos\alpha\sin\beta\) ki shakal hai: \(x\) ki jagah \(\sin\alpha\), aur \(\sqrt{1-y^{2}}\) ki jagah \(\cos\beta\). Yani har term mein ek number aur doosre number ka 'saathi' square root.
Cosine wale (iii) aur (iv) mein pehle \(xy\) aata hai (dono cosines ka product), phir dono sines ka product \(\sqrt{(1-x^{2})(1-y^{2})}\). Sign ulta hai: jama ke liye minus, farq ke liye plus, bilkul \(\cos(\alpha \pm \beta)\) ki tarah.
Tangent wale (v) aur (vi) sab se saaf hain, kyunke in mein koi square root nahi: upar jama ya farq, neeche 1 aur product, sign ulta.
Kab kaunsa lagayein? Seedha usool: jis function mein jawab chahiye, usi ka formula lagaiye. Agar sawal mein \(\sin^{-1}\) hain aur jawab \(\cos^{-1}\) mein maanga hai, to pehle angles ko \(\cos^{-1}\) mein badaliye (Example 8 wala tareeqa), phir (iii) ya (iv) lagaiye.

blocks.title: Remember!
blocks.text:
\(\sin(\alpha \pm \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta \pm \cos\alpha\sin\beta\)
\(\cos(\alpha \pm \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta \mp \sin\alpha\sin\beta\)
\(\tan(\alpha \pm \beta) = \frac{\tan\alpha \pm \tan\beta}{1 \mp \tan\alpha\tan\beta}\)

Yeh Remember! box poore sabaq ki chaabi hai, kyunke har proof inhi teen formulas se shuru hota hai. Agar yahan ek sign bhi ghalat yaad ho gaya to aage har jawab ghalat aayega. Is liye neeche wali ghaltiyan ghor se dekhiye aur sahi shakal apni copy mein likh lijiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab ke Remember! box mein teen ghaltiyan hain; upar sahi shakal likhi hai.
1. Sine wale formula mein ek faltu bracket chhapa hai: \(\sin\alpha\cos\beta)\).
2. Cosine wale formula mein kitab \(\pm\) chhapti hai, jabke sahi \(\mp\) hai: jama ke liye minus, farq ke liye plus. Test: \(\alpha = \beta = \frac{\pi}{4}\) par \(\cos\frac{\pi}{2} = 0\), aur \(\frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{2} = 0\) sahi aata hai, jabke \(\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{2} = 1\) ghalat hai.
3. Tangent ke denominator mein bhi kitab \(1 \pm \tan\alpha\tan\beta\) chhapti hai, sahi \(1 \mp \tan\alpha\tan\beta\) hai. Formula (v) ke proof mein kitab khud sahi shakal \(1 - \tan\alpha\tan\beta\) istemal karti hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Har formula kab sahi hai? Kitab sirf itna kehti hai ke yeh principal values ke andar sahi hain, lekin shart (condition) nahi batati. Wajah samajhiye: har formula ka right side hamesha principal value hota hai (masalan \(\sin^{-1}\) ka jawab \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein), is liye left side ko bhi usi interval mein aana chahiye. Neeche table mein sab sharten hain; hum ne inhein hazaron values par computer se check kiya hai.
Misaal: \(\tan^{-1}2 + \tan^{-1}3 \approx 1.1071 + 1.2490 = 2.3562\), yani \(\frac{3\pi}{4}\). Formula (v) andha dhund lagayein to \(\tan^{-1}\frac{5}{-5} = \tan^{-1}(-1) = -\frac{\pi}{4}\) aata hai, jo ghalat hai, kyunke yahan \(xy = 6 > 1\).
Exercise 9.2 ke Questions 1 se 9 mein har jore ki shart poori hoti hai, is liye wahan formulas seedhe lag jate hain.

blocks.caption: Formulas ki sharten (hamari taraf se, kitab mein nahi); (i) se (iv) mein \(-1 \le x, y \le 1\) bhi

blocks.text: Table ko ratna zaroori nahi. Asal baat samajhni hai: left side ka angle right side wale function ki principal range mein hona chahiye. Positive numbers ke saath (jaise exercise ke tamam numerical sawalon mein) sirf teen sharten yaad rakhiye: sine ke jama mein \(x^{2} + y^{2} \le 1\), cosine ke farq mein \(x \le y\), aur tangent ke jama mein \(xy < 1\).
Ab formula (i) ka proof dekhte hain. Ghor se dekhiye ke teen qadam (naam, formula, wapsi) kaise chalte hain.

Maan lijiye
\[\sin^{-1}x = \alpha \Rightarrow \sin\alpha = x\]
aur
\[\sin^{-1}y = \beta \Rightarrow \sin\beta = y\]
Yeh pehla qadam hai: inverse ko naam de diya, aur inverse ki definition se \(\sin\alpha = x\) likh diya.

Ab
\[\cos\alpha = \pm\sqrt{1-\sin^{2}\alpha}\]
\[= \pm\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\]
Kyunke \(\alpha, \beta \in \left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\), is liye \(\cos\alpha, \cos\beta \ge 0\)
\[\therefore\ \cos\alpha = \sqrt{1-x^{2}}\]
Isi tarah \(\cos\beta = \sqrt{1-y^{2}}\)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: \(\pm\) kyun hata diya? \(\alpha = \sin^{-1}x\) ek principal value hai, yani \(-\frac{\pi}{2} \le \alpha \le \frac{\pi}{2}\). Yeh angle pehle ya chauthe (fourth) quadrant mein hai, jahan cosine kabhi negative nahi hota. Yahi woh jagah hai jahan principal values har proof mein dakhil hoti hain. \(\cos^{-1}\) ke liye angle \([0, \pi]\) mein hota hai, wahan sine negative nahi hota. Khud sochiye: agar \(\alpha\) doosre quadrant mein hota to kya \(\cos\alpha\) positive rehta?

Ab doosra qadam: purana formula
\[\sin(\alpha+\beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta\]
\[\sin(\alpha+\beta) = x\sqrt{1-y^{2}} + y\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\]
Teesra qadam: dono taraf \(\sin^{-1}\)
\[\Rightarrow \alpha + \beta\]
\[= \sin^{-1}\left(x\sqrt{1-y^{2}} + y\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\right)\]
Yani,
\[\sin^{-1}x + \sin^{-1}y\]
\[= \sin^{-1}\left(x\sqrt{1-y^{2}} + y\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\right)\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Qadam \(\sin(\alpha + \beta) = k \Rightarrow \alpha + \beta = \sin^{-1}k\) tabhi jaiz hai jab \(\alpha + \beta\) khud \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein ho. Positive \(x, y\) ke liye yeh bilkul table wali shart \(x^{2} + y^{2} \le 1\) hai. Misaal: \(\sin^{-1}1 + \sin^{-1}1 = \pi\), lekin formula \(\sin^{-1}0 = 0\) deta hai. Yaad rakhiye: formula andha nahi lagana, pehle shart dekhni hai.

Zara ruk kar dekhiye ke abhi kya hua. Humein do inverse sines ka jama chahiye tha. Hum ne unhein angles \(\alpha\) aur \(\beta\) ka naam diya, cosines ko principal range ki madad se bina kisi shak ke positive liya, sine ka jama wala purana formula lagaya, aur aakhir mein dono taraf \(\sin^{-1}\) le kar wapas aa gaye. Yahi teen qadam baqi paanch formulas mein bhi chalte hain; sirf formula badalta hai, tareeqa nahi. Is liye ek proof achhi tarah samajh liya to baqi khud ban jate hain.
Isi tarah (ii), (iii) aur (iv) bhi prove hote hain.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Neeche dekhne se pehle khud koshish kijiye, phir milaiye:
(ii) (i) jaisa hi shuru, lekin \(\sin(\alpha - \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta - \cos\alpha\sin\beta\) lagaiye.
(iii) \(\cos^{-1}x = \alpha\), \(\cos^{-1}y = \beta\) maaniye. Ab \(\alpha, \beta \in [0, \pi]\), is liye \(\sin\alpha = \sqrt{1-x^{2}}\), \(\sin\beta = \sqrt{1-y^{2}}\) (wahan sine negative nahi). Phir \(\cos(\alpha + \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta - \sin\alpha\sin\beta = xy - \sqrt{(1-x^{2})(1-y^{2})}\), aur dono taraf \(\cos^{-1}\).
(iv) Bilkul wahi, bas \(\cos(\alpha - \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta\).

Ab tangent ki baari. Exam mein sab se zyada sawal isi formula (v) aur (vi) se aate hain, kyunke tangent ke formula mein koi square root nahi hota aur hisaab jaldi ho jata hai. Proof bhi sab se chhota hai: yahan \(\tan\alpha\) aur \(\tan\beta\) seedhe \(x\) aur \(y\) hain, is liye sign ka koi jhagra hi nahi. Bas ek baat dhyan mein rakhiye: tangent ki principal range \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) khuli (open) hai, aur do angles ka jama is se bahar ja sakta hai; wahi shart \(xy < 1\) ka sabab hai.

Ab formula (v) ka proof:
Maan lijiye
\[\tan^{-1}x = \alpha \Rightarrow \tan\alpha = x\]
aur
\[\tan^{-1}y = \beta \Rightarrow \tan\beta = y\]
Ab
\[\tan(\alpha+\beta) = \dfrac{\tan\alpha + \tan\beta}{1 - \tan\alpha\tan\beta}\]
\[\tan(\alpha+\beta) = \dfrac{x+y}{1-xy}\]
\[\Rightarrow \alpha+\beta = \tan^{-1}\dfrac{x+y}{1-xy}\]
Yani,
\[\tan^{-1}x + \tan^{-1}y\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{x+y}{1-xy}\]
Yahan \(\tan\alpha\) aur \(\tan\beta\) seedhe \(x\) aur \(y\) hain, is liye koi square root nikalne ki zaroorat hi nahi pari. Isi wajah se tangent wala formula sab se aasaan hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Formula (v) mein \(1 - xy \ne 0\) hona chahiye (warna fraction undefined), balke asal shart \(xy < 1\) hai. Agar \(x, y > 0\) aur \(xy > 1\) ho to sahi jawab \(\pi + \tan^{-1}\frac{x+y}{1-xy}\) hota hai.

Ab formula (v) mein \(y = x\) rakhein:
\[\tan^{-1}x + \tan^{-1}x\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\dfrac{x+x}{1-xx}\]
\[\Rightarrow 2\tan^{-1}x = \tan^{-1}\dfrac{2x}{1-x^{2}}\]
Isi tarah formula (vi) bhi prove hota hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: (vi) ke liye wahi \(\alpha\), \(\beta\) lein aur \(\tan(\alpha - \beta) = \frac{\tan\alpha - \tan\beta}{1 + \tan\alpha\tan\beta} = \frac{x - y}{1 + xy}\) lagayein. Double wala natija \(2\tan^{-1}x = \tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1-x^{2}}\): shart \(xy < 1\) mein \(y = x\) rakhein to \(x^{2} < 1\), yani \(-1 < x < 1\). Yeh natija Exercise 9.2 ke Questions 6 aur 8 mein kaam aata hai, is liye ise achhi tarah yaad kar lijiye.

Double wale natije kyun zaroori hain? Jab sawal mein \(2\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{4}\) ya \(2\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\) jaisa term ho, to 2 ko seedha andar nahi le ja sakte. Pehle double wala formula laga kar ise ek akela \(\tan^{-1}\) banate hain, phir baqi terms ke saath jorte hain. Yahi kaam sine aur cosine ke liye bhi ho sakta hai, jaisa neeche hai.

Isi tarah formula (i) aur (iii) mein \(y = x\) rakhne se yeh do natije milte hain:
\[2\sin^{-1}x = \sin^{-1}\left(2x\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\right)\]
aur
\[2\cos^{-1}x = \cos^{-1}\left(2x^{2}-1\right)\]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke yeh dono natije '(i) aur (ii)' se nikalte hain. Pehla (i) se nikalta hai, lekin (ii) mein \(y = x\) rakhne se sirf \(\sin^{-1}0 = 0\) milta hai. Doosra natija (iii) se aata hai: \(y = x\) rakhein to \(x \cdot x - \sqrt{(1-x^{2})(1-x^{2})} = x^{2} - (1 - x^{2}) = 2x^{2} - 1\). Sahi baat: '(i) aur (iii) se'.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Pehla natija kaise bana: (i) mein \(y = x\) rakhein: \(x\sqrt{1-x^{2}} + x\sqrt{1-x^{2}} = 2x\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\).
Sharten (kitab mein nahi): \(2\sin^{-1}x = \sin^{-1}(2x\sqrt{1-x^{2}})\) ko \(|x| \le \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) chahiye, taa ke \(2\alpha\) bhi \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein rahe. \(2\cos^{-1}x = \cos^{-1}(2x^{2}-1)\) ko \(0 \le x \le 1\) chahiye, taa ke \(2\alpha\) \([0, \pi]\) mein rahe.
Test: pehle mein \(x = 1\) rakhein to left side \(2\sin^{-1}1 = \pi\), lekin right side \(\sin^{-1}0 = 0\). Shart toot gayi, jawab ghalat.
Ab kitab ki misaalein. Pehli misaal mein hum dekhenge ke ek inverse function ko doosre mein kaise badalte hain; yeh hunar (skill) poori exercise mein chahiye.

Example 8 mein sawal yeh hai: \(\cos^{-1}x\) ko \(\sin^{-1}\) ki zubaan mein kaise likhein? Is ka jawab ek right triangle mein chhupa hai. Agar kisi angle ka cosine \(x\) hai to us ka sine \(\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\) hai, bas sign ka khayal rakhna hai. Dekhte hain kitab yeh kaam kaise karti hai, aur kahan woh ek zaroori shart bhool jati hai.

blocks.title: Example 8
steps:
Diya gaya: angle \(\cos^{-1}x\), jahan \(-1 \le x \le 1\).
Maloom karna (prove): \(\cos^{-1}x = \sin^{-1}\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\).
Tareeqa: sab se pehle angle ko ek naam dete hain, \(\alpha = \cos^{-1}x\). Phir \(\sin^{2}\alpha + \cos^{2}\alpha = 1\) se \(\sin\alpha\) nikalenge, aur aakhir mein dono taraf \(\sin^{-1}\) lenge. Yahi woh tareeqa hai jis se ek \(\cos^{-1}\) ko \(\sin^{-1}\) mein badla jata hai. Yaad rakhiye, poore section mein yahi chaal baar baar aayegi.

Angle ko naam dein
\[\alpha = \cos^{-1}x\]
\[\cos\alpha = x\]
Kyun: \(y = \cos^{-1}x\) ka matlab hai \(x = \cos y\), aur \(y\) hamesha \([0, \pi]\) mein hota hai. Is liye hamara \(\alpha\) bhi \([0, \pi]\) mein hai. Yeh choti si baat aage bohat kaam aayegi.

\(\sin\alpha\) nikalein
\[\sin\alpha = \sqrt{1-\cos^{2}\alpha}\]
\[= \sqrt{1-x^{2}}\]
Kyun: \(\sin^{2}\alpha + \cos^{2}\alpha = 1\) se \(\sin^{2}\alpha = 1 - x^{2}\). Square root lete waqt normally \(\pm\) aata hai, lekin \(\alpha\) to \([0, \pi]\) mein hai (pehla aur doosra quadrant), jahan sine kabhi negative nahi hota. Is liye sirf positive root rakha.
Dhyan dein: yahan minus sign ko bina wajah ke mat chhoriye; wajah hamesha likhiye: '\(\alpha \in [0, \pi]\), is liye \(\sin\alpha \ge 0\)'.

Dono taraf \(\sin^{-1}\) lein
\[\Rightarrow \alpha = \sin^{-1}\left(\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\right)\]
\[\therefore\ \cos^{-1}x = \sin^{-1}\left(\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\right)\]
Kyun: \(\sin\alpha = k\) se \(\alpha = \sin^{-1}k\) tabhi likh sakte hain jab \(\alpha\) principal range \([-\pi/2, \pi/2]\) ke andar ho, kyunke \(\sin^{-1}\) is range se bahar ka angle de hi nahi sakta. Hamara \(\alpha\) \([0, \pi]\) mein hai; dono baatein saath tabhi sach hain jab \(0 \le \alpha \le \pi/2\), yani \(0 \le x \le 1\). Kitab yeh shart (condition) nahi likhti; neeche 'Kitab ki ghalti' dekhiye.

Tasdeeq: \(x = \frac{1}{2}\) rakh kar
\[\cos^{-1}\tfrac{1}{2} = \tfrac{\pi}{3}\]
\[\sin^{-1}\sqrt{1-\tfrac{1}{4}} = \sin^{-1}\tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
\[= \tfrac{\pi}{3}\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: dono taraf ek hi angle \(60^{\circ}\) aaya, is liye positive \(x\) ke liye natija sahi hai. Ab khud \(x = -\frac{1}{2}\) rakh kar dekhiye ke kya hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab \(\cos^{-1}x = \sin^{-1}\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\) ko bina kisi shart ke likhti hai, jaise yeh \([-1, 1]\) ke har \(x\) ke liye sach ho. Asal mein yeh sirf \(0 \le x \le 1\) ke liye sach hai. Negative \(x\) ke liye \(\cos^{-1}x\) ka angle \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) se bara hota hai, jabke \(\sin^{-1}\) kabhi \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) se bara angle nahi deta. Misaal: \(\cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right) = \frac{2\pi}{3}\), lekin \(\sin^{-1}\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{\pi}{3}\). Sahi bayan: \(0 \le x \le 1\) ke liye \(\cos^{-1}x = \sin^{-1}\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\), aur \(-1 \le x < 0\) ke liye \(\cos^{-1}x = \pi - \sin^{-1}\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(x = -\frac{1}{2}\) par dono taraf kya aata hai? Left side: \(\cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right) = \frac{2\pi}{3}\), yani \(120^{\circ}\). Right side: \(\sin^{-1}\sqrt{1 - \frac{1}{4}} = \sin^{-1}\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{\pi}{3}\), yani \(60^{\circ}\). Dono barabar nahi! Wajah: \(\sin 120^{\circ}\) aur \(\sin 60^{\circ}\) dono \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) hain, aur \(\sin^{-1}\) hamesha chhota wala (principal) angle chunta hai. Is liye negative \(x\) ke liye jawab \(\pi - \sin^{-1}\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\) banta hai: \(\pi - \frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{2\pi}{3}\). Sahi!

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Yahi triangle wala idea kisi bhi inverse ko doosre inverse mein badal deta hai. Agar \(\alpha = \cos^{-1}x\) aur \(0 < x < 1\), to ek right triangle banaiye jis ka adjacent side \(x\) aur hypotenuse 1 ho. Pythagoras se opposite side \(\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\). Ab teenon ratios saamne hain: \(\alpha = \sin^{-1}\sqrt{1-x^{2}} = \tan^{-1}\frac{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}{x}\). Exercise 9.2 mein jab sawal \(\sin^{-1}\) mein ho aur jawab \(\cos^{-1}\) mein, to yahi kaam karna parta hai.

Ab Example 9. Yeh pehli misaal hai jis mein formula (i) numbers par chalta hai. Exercise 9.2 ke zyada tar sawal bilkul isi qisam ke hain: do ya teen inverse angles, fractions ke saath, aur jawab ek saaf angle ya ek inverse function. Is misaal ko qadam ba qadam samajh liya to aadhi exercise aasaan ho jayegi. Har qadam par apne aap se poochiye: 'Main yeh kyun kar raha hoon?'

blocks.title: Example 9
steps:
Diya gaya: do angles \(\sin^{-1}\frac{5}{13}\) aur \(\sin^{-1}\frac{12}{13}\).
Maloom karna (prove): in ka jama \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) hai.
Tareeqa: dono terms \(\sin^{-1}\) hain aur jama ho rahe hain, is liye formula (i) bilkul fit hai: \(\sin^{-1}x + \sin^{-1}y = \sin^{-1}\left(x\sqrt{1-y^{2}} + y\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\right)\). Pehle shart check karte hain: \(x^{2} + y^{2} = \frac{25}{169} + \frac{144}{169} = 1\), jo \(\le 1\) hai, is liye formula lagana jaiz hai.

Numbers ko naam dein
\[x = \tfrac{5}{13},\quad y = \tfrac{12}{13}\]
Kyun: naam de dene se formula mein values rakhna seedha aur saaf ho jata hai, aur ghalti ka chance kam hota hai.

Dono square roots pehle nikal lein
\[\sqrt{1-y^{2}} = \sqrt{1-\tfrac{144}{169}} = \sqrt{\tfrac{25}{169}}\]
\[= \tfrac{5}{13}\]
\[\sqrt{1-x^{2}} = \sqrt{1-\tfrac{25}{169}} = \sqrt{\tfrac{144}{169}}\]
\[= \tfrac{12}{13}\]
Kyun: formula (i) ke andar yahi do roots hain. Kitab yeh kaam bracket ke andar karti hai; hum pehle alag se kar lete hain taa ke har line chhoti aur saaf rahe. Ghor kijiye: 5, 12, 13 ek Pythagorean triple hai (\(5^{2} + 12^{2} = 13^{2}\)), is liye roots itne saaf nikle.

Formula (i) mein values rakhein
\[\sin^{-1}\tfrac{5}{13} + \sin^{-1}\tfrac{12}{13}\]
\[= \sin^{-1}\left(\tfrac{5}{13}\cdot\tfrac{5}{13} + \tfrac{12}{13}\cdot\tfrac{12}{13}\right)\]
\[= \sin^{-1}\left(\tfrac{25}{169} + \tfrac{144}{169}\right)\]
\[= \sin^{-1}\left(\tfrac{169}{169}\right) = \sin^{-1}(1)\]
\[= \tfrac{\pi}{2}\]
Kyun: \(x\sqrt{1-y^{2}} = \frac{5}{13}\cdot\frac{5}{13}\) aur \(y\sqrt{1-x^{2}} = \frac{12}{13}\cdot\frac{12}{13}\). Jama 1 aaya. Aakhir mein: kaunsa angle hai jis ka sine 1 hai aur jo \([-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}]\) mein hai? Woh \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\sin^{-1}\tfrac{5}{13} \approx 0.3948\]
\[\sin^{-1}\tfrac{12}{13} \approx 1.1760\]
\[0.3948 + 1.1760 = 1.5708 \approx \tfrac{\pi}{2}\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: calculator (radian mode) bhi yahi kehta hai. Ek aur khoobsurat tareeqa: 5, 12, 13 wali triangle mein \(\sin^{-1}\frac{12}{13} = \cos^{-1}\frac{5}{13}\), aur Example 5 ke mutabiq \(\sin^{-1}u + \cos^{-1}u = \frac{\pi}{2}\). Do raaste, ek hi jawab.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahi. Prove kijiye: \(\sin^{-1}\frac{3}{5} + \sin^{-1}\frac{4}{5} = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Shart: \(\frac{9}{25} + \frac{16}{25} = 1 \le 1\), theek hai.
Roots: \(\sqrt{1 - \frac{16}{25}} = \frac{3}{5}\), \(\sqrt{1 - \frac{9}{25}} = \frac{4}{5}\).
Formula (i): \(\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{5}\cdot\frac{3}{5} + \frac{4}{5}\cdot\frac{4}{5}\right) = \sin^{-1}\frac{25}{25} = \sin^{-1}1 = \frac{\pi}{2}\). Saabit!
Ghor kijiye: 3, 4, 5 bhi Pythagorean triple hai, aur jab dono numbers ek hi triangle ke do sides se banein to jawab hamesha \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) aata hai.

Example 10 mein numbers ki jagah letters hain, \(x\) aur \(y\). Ghabraiye mat: tareeqa wahi hai, sirf algebra thori lambi hai. Asal imtihaan yahan fractions ko saaf karne ka hai: fraction ke andar fraction ho to sab ko ek common denominator par le aaiye, woh upar neeche se cancel ho jata hai. Kitab ki is misaal mein ek sign ki ghalti bhi hai; hum use pakar kar sahi kar ke dikhayenge.

blocks.title: Example 10
steps:
Diya gaya: expression \(\tan^{-1}\frac{x}{y} - \tan^{-1}\frac{x-y}{x+y}\).
Maloom karna (prove): yeh \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) ke barabar hai.
Tareeqa: do \(\tan^{-1}\) terms ka farq (difference) hai, is liye formula (vi) lagayenge: \(\tan^{-1}a - \tan^{-1}b = \tan^{-1}\frac{a-b}{1+ab}\), jahan \(a = \frac{x}{y}\), \(b = \frac{x-y}{x+y}\). Phir compound fraction (fraction ke andar fraction) ko common denominator \(y(x+y)\) se saaf karenge.

Formula (vi) lagayein
\[\text{L.H.S} = \tan^{-1}\dfrac{\dfrac{x}{y} - \dfrac{x-y}{x+y}}{1 + \dfrac{x}{y}\cdot\dfrac{x-y}{x+y}}\]
Kyun: upar \(a - b\) aur neeche \(1 + ab\). Formula ke numbers ko yahan \(a\) aur \(b\) kaha taa ke sawal ke \(x\), \(y\) ke saath gadbad na ho.

Upar wala hissa (numerator) saaf karein
\[\tfrac{x}{y} - \tfrac{x-y}{x+y} = \dfrac{x(x+y) - y(x-y)}{y(x+y)}\]
\[= \dfrac{x^{2} + xy - yx + y^{2}}{y(x+y)}\]
Kyun: \(y\) aur \(x+y\) ka common denominator \(y(x+y)\) hai. Dhyan dein: \(-y(x-y) = -yx + y^{2}\); minus ko bracket ke dono terms par lagana hai.

Neeche wala hissa (denominator) saaf karein
\[1 + \tfrac{x}{y}\cdot\tfrac{x-y}{x+y}\]
\[= \dfrac{yx + y^{2} + x^{2} - xy}{y(x+y)}\]
\[= \dfrac{x^{2} + y^{2}}{y(x+y)}\]
Kyun: \(1 = \frac{y(x+y)}{y(x+y)} = \frac{yx + y^{2}}{y(x+y)}\), aur \(\frac{x}{y}\cdot\frac{x-y}{x+y} = \frac{x^{2} - xy}{y(x+y)}\). Jama karein to \(yx\) aur \(-xy\) cancel ho jate hain. Kitab yahan aakhri term \(+xy\) chhapti hai, jo ghalat hai; neeche 'Kitab ki ghalti' dekhiye.

Common denominator cancel karein
\[= \tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{x^{2} + xy - xy + y^{2}}{xy + y^{2} + x^{2} - xy}\right)\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{x^{2} + y^{2}}{x^{2} + y^{2}}\right)\]
Kyun: upar aur neeche dono ka denominator \(y(x+y)\) hai, is liye woh cancel ho gaya. Upar \(xy - xy = 0\) aur neeche bhi \(xy - xy = 0\). Dono taraf \(x^{2} + y^{2}\) bacha.

Aakhri qadam
\[= \tan^{-1}(1) = \tfrac{\pi}{4} = \text{R.H.S}\]
Kyun: \(\tan\frac{\pi}{4} = 1\), aur \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) principal range \((-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2})\) mein hai.

Tasdeeq: \(x = 3,\ y = 1\) rakh kar
\[\tan^{-1}3 - \tan^{-1}\tfrac{2}{4}\]
\[\approx 1.2490 - 0.4636 = 0.7854\]
\[\tfrac{\pi}{4} \approx 0.7854\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: letters ki jagah numbers rakh kar identity ko calculator (radian mode) par test kar sakte hain. Yeh aadat exam mein bohat kaam aati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab working mein denominator \(yx + y^{2} + x^{2} + xy\) aur agli line mein \(xy + y^{2} + x^{2} + xy\) chhapti hai. Dono mein aakhri term \(-xy\) honi chahiye: \(y(x+y) + x(x-y) = xy + y^{2} + x^{2} - xy = x^{2} + y^{2}\). Kitab ki agli line \(\tan^{-1}\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}}{x^{2}+y^{2}}\) aur jawab \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) sahi hain. Kitab koi shart bhi nahi likhti: formula (vi) ko \(ab > -1\) chahiye, jo yahan \(y(x+y) > 0\) banta hai (masalan \(x, y > 0\)). \(x = 1,\ y = -\frac{1}{2}\) par left side \(-\frac{3\pi}{4}\) aata hai, \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) nahi.

Example 11 is sabaq ki aakhri aur sab se dilchasp misaal hai, kyunke yahan hum kuch prove nahi kar rahe balke ek equation hal kar rahe hain. Formula (v) do inverse tangents ko ek bana deta hai; phir \(\tan\) lene se ek aam algebraic equation ban jati hai jo aap bachpan se hal karte aaye hain. Lekin ek khatra hai: formula (v) har jagah sahi nahi, is liye algebra kabhi kabhi ek nakli (false) jawab bhi de deti hai. Hum dono jawab test karenge.

blocks.title: Example 11
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\tan^{-1}\frac{x-1}{x+1} + \tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{x+1} = \frac{\pi}{4}\), jahan \(x \ne -1\) (warna denominator zero).
Maloom karna: woh tamam \(x\) jo is equation ko poora karte hain.
Tareeqa: formula (v) se dono angles ko ek angle mein jorenge, phir dono taraf \(\tan\) lenge, aur jo algebraic equation banegi use hal karenge. Formula (v) sirf \(ab < 1\) par sahi hai, is liye har root ko asal equation mein rakh kar test karna zaroori hai.

Formula (v) se dono terms jorein
\[\tan^{-1}\dfrac{\dfrac{x-1}{x+1} + \dfrac{2x}{x+1}}{1 - \dfrac{x-1}{x+1}\cdot\dfrac{2x}{x+1}} = \dfrac{\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: \(\tan^{-1}a + \tan^{-1}b = \tan^{-1}\frac{a+b}{1-ab}\), jahan \(a = \frac{x-1}{x+1}\), \(b = \frac{2x}{x+1}\). Do angles ab ek angle ban gaye.

Upar wala hissa
\[\dfrac{x-1}{x+1} + \dfrac{2x}{x+1} = \dfrac{3x-1}{x+1}\]
Kyun: denominators same hain, is liye sirf numerators jama kiye: \((x - 1) + 2x = 3x - 1\).

Neeche wala hissa
\[1 - \dfrac{2x(x-1)}{(x+1)^{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{(x+1)^{2} - 2x^{2} + 2x}{(x+1)^{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{-x^{2} + 4x + 1}{(x+1)^{2}}\]
Kyun: \((x+1)^{2} = x^{2} + 2x + 1\), to upar \(x^{2} + 2x + 1 - 2x^{2} + 2x = -x^{2} + 4x + 1\). Kitab yeh line chhor kar seedha natija likhti hai; hum ne beech ka qadam dikha diya.

Dono taraf tan lein
\[\dfrac{3x-1}{x+1}\cdot\dfrac{(x+1)^{2}}{-x^{2}+4x+1} = \tan\dfrac{\pi}{4}\]
\[\Rightarrow \dfrac{3x-1}{x+1}\cdot\dfrac{(x+1)^{2}}{-x^{2}+4x+1} = 1\]
Kyun: agar \(\tan^{-1}u = \frac{\pi}{4}\) ho to \(u = \tan\frac{\pi}{4} = 1\). Fraction se divide karna uske ulte (reciprocal) se multiply karna hai.

Fractions khatam karein
\[(3x-1)(x+1) = -x^{2} + 4x + 1\]
\[3x^{2} + 2x - 1 = -x^{2} + 4x + 1\]
\[4x^{2} - 2x - 2 = 0\]
\[2x^{2} - x - 1 = 0\]
Kyun: ek \((x+1)\) cancel kiya (jaiz hai kyunke \(x \ne -1\)), phir cross multiply, sab terms left par laaye aur 2 se divide kiya.

Factorise karein
\[(x-1)(2x+1) = 0\]
\[x - 1 = 0 \text{ or } 2x + 1 = 0\]
\[x = 1 \text{ or } x = -\tfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: middle term ko torte hain: \(2x^{2} - 2x + x - 1 = 2x(x-1) + 1(x-1)\).

\(x = -\frac{1}{2}\) ko asal equation mein test karein
\[\tfrac{x-1}{x+1} = \tfrac{-3/2}{1/2} = -3\]
\[\tfrac{2x}{x+1} = \tfrac{-1}{1/2} = -2\]
\[\tan^{-1}(-3) + \tan^{-1}(-2) = -\tfrac{3\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: dono angles negative hain, un ka jama \(+\frac{\pi}{4}\) ho hi nahi sakta. Yahan \(ab = (-3)(-2) = 6 > 1\), yani formula (v) ki shart toot gayi; isi raaste se yeh nakli (false) root andar aaya. Is liye \(x = -\frac{1}{2}\) equation ko satisfy nahi karta.
Dhyan dein: yeh test chhorna exam ki sab se aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq: \(x = 1\)
\[\tan^{-1}\tfrac{0}{2} + \tan^{-1}\tfrac{2}{2} = 0 + \tfrac{\pi}{4}\]
\[= \tfrac{\pi}{4}\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: \(x = 1\) asal equation ko poora karta hai. Is liye sirf \(x = 1\) hi hal (solution) hai.
blocks.answer: Sirf \(x = 1\) hal hai (\(x = -\frac{1}{2}\) equation ko satisfy nahi karta).

blocks.text: Is sabaq ka khulasa (summary) yeh hai: sum aur difference formulas do inverse functions ko ek mein jor dete hain, lekin har formula ki ek shart hai jo principal ranges se aati hai. Proof mein yeh shart square root ka sign tay karti hai, aur equations mein yeh nakli roots ko pakarne mein madad karti hai. Exercise 9.2 mein aap yahi teen kaam baar baar karenge: angle ko doosre inverse function mein badalna, sahi formula chun kar lagana, aur jawab ko calculator ya asal equation se check karna.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Inverse functions wali har equation mein har root ko asal equation mein wapas rakhiye aur har ek ke liye ek line likhiye: 'satisfy karta hai' ya 'satisfy nahi karta'. Examiner nakli root ko wajah ke saath reject karne par alag mark deta hai. Yeh aisa hi hai jaise dukaan se wapas aa kar bill check karna: chhota sa kaam, magar nuqsan se bacha leta hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh bhi hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahi. Formula (iii) ko chala kar dekhte hain: \(\cos^{-1}\frac{3}{5} + \cos^{-1}\frac{4}{5}\) kitna hai?
Shart: \(x + y = \frac{7}{5} \ge 0\), theek hai.
Roots: \(\sqrt{1 - \frac{9}{25}} = \frac{4}{5}\), \(\sqrt{1 - \frac{16}{25}} = \frac{3}{5}\).
Formula (iii): \(\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{5}\cdot\frac{4}{5} - \frac{4}{5}\cdot\frac{3}{5}\right) = \cos^{-1}0 = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Matlab yeh dono angles mil kar right angle banate hain, jo 3, 4, 5 triangle ke do acute angles hain. Tasdeeq: \(0.9273 + 0.6435 = 1.5708\).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{2} + \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\) kitna hai? Pehle shart dekhiye: \(xy = \frac{1}{6} < 1\), theek. Phir formula (v): \(\frac{\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{3}}{1 - \frac{1}{6}} = \frac{5/6}{5/6} = 1\). Jawab: \(\tan^{-1}1 = \frac{\pi}{4}\).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Chhe formulas: (i), (ii) \(\sin^{-1}x \pm \sin^{-1}y\) ke liye; (iii), (iv) \(\cos^{-1}x \pm \cos^{-1}y\) ke liye; (v), (vi) \(\tan^{-1}x \pm \tan^{-1}y\) ke liye.
2. Proof ka tareeqa: angles ko naam do (\(\alpha, \beta\)), sin/cos/tan ka jama ya farq wala formula lagao, phir dono taraf inverse lo.
3. Positive square root principal range ki wajah se: \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) par cosine negative nahi, \([0, \pi]\) par sine negative nahi.
4. Har formula ki ek shart hai; sab se zyada istemal hone wali: (v) ko \(xy < 1\), (vi) ko \(xy > -1\).
5. Double natije: \(2\tan^{-1}x = \tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1-x^{2}}\) (\(|x| < 1\)), \(2\sin^{-1}x = \sin^{-1}(2x\sqrt{1-x^{2}})\), \(2\cos^{-1}x = \cos^{-1}(2x^{2}-1)\).
6. \(\cos^{-1}x = \sin^{-1}\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\) sirf \(0 \le x \le 1\) ke liye (Example 8).
7. Equations mein har root ko asal equation mein test karo (Example 11).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\sin^{-1}x + \sin^{-1}y = \sin^{-1}(x + y)\) likh dena. Inverse functions aise jama nahi hote; formula (i) lagaiye.
2. \(2\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{4} = \tan^{-1}\frac{2}{4}\) likh dena. 2 angle ko double karta hai, number ko nahi: \(\tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1-x^{2}}\) lagaiye.
3. \(\cos(\alpha + \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta\) likhna (jaise kitab ke ghalat chhape Remember! box mein). Jama ke liye sign minus hai.
4. \(xy > 1\) par formula (v) lagana: \(\tan^{-1}2 + \tan^{-1}3 = \frac{3\pi}{4}\) hai, \(-\frac{\pi}{4}\) nahi.
5. Example 11 jaise sawal mein \(x = -\frac{1}{2}\) ko bina test kiye jawab mein rakh lena.
